# `assets/material/EngineMaterial.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/material/EngineMaterial.js`

engine/assets/material/EngineMaterial.js — normalized material + texture binding schemas (spec §7). Materials are decoded, not guessed. Textures bind to surfaces (not loose images); UV sets, sampler wrap/filter, and texture transforms must survive import; packed channels are read exactly. The raw source material is always preserved on `.original` so the imported look stays recoverable even after engine normalization or shader-model approximation.

## Functions

### `defaultChannelMap(slot)`

glTF default packing: metallic=B, roughness=G, occlusion=R.

### `createEngineMaterial(init = {})`

Create a normalized engine material.

### `createTextureBinding(init = {})`

Create a texture binding (a texture bound to a material slot on a surface).

### `hasTextureTransform(binding)`

Has this binding a non-identity UV transform (KHR_texture_transform)?

- `WORKFLOW`
- `ALPHA_MODE`
- `TEXTURE_SLOTS`
- `COLOR_SPACE`
- `TEXTURE_USAGE`
